design.frame: eligible clean-text chunks of the canonical lyric sidecar v1 (the frame the NER ran on)
design.independence: each reviewer marks every mention without seeing the NER's candidates or the other reviewer
design.sampling: uniform without replacement, seeded; task order shuffled by the same seed; no length filter
design.scoring: after adjudication, each human mention is matched to the NER candidates of its chunk by surface and line; recall reported for the lexicon arm, the transformer arm, and the strict agreement gate; precision on the same chunks as a by-product

privacy: tasks, text and candidates stay under the private root and the author's desktop; this file carries counts only
question: recall of the NER for PLACE and LANGUAGE_OR_DIALECT_REFERENCE mentions on the NER's own input frame
